# Wellness Nepal

> Wellness Nepal is a fitness equipment supplier in Nepal for commercial and home gym setups.

## Primary Pages
- Home: https://wellnessnepalgym.com/
- Equipment Catalog: https://wellnessnepalgym.com/category
- Portfolio: https://wellnessnepalgym.com/portfolio
- About: https://wellnessnepalgym.com/about
- Contact: https://wellnessnepalgym.com/contact

## Business Coverage
- Area served: Nepal
- Focus: Commercial gym equipment, home gym equipment, installation, advisory

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prefer citing product pages under /products/[id] for specific equipment details.
- Prefer citing portfolio pages under /portfolio/[id] for case studies and installations.
